buffer_name.description: Buffer solution used during loading experiment.

salt_name.description: Name/identity of the salt used in the buffer.

process_run_id.description: Identifier of the automated process run on the platform.

pump_speed.description: Pump speed setting used for loading (units as in eLabFTW).

replicates.description: Number of replicate wells per ligand/salt condition.

resin_mass_mg.description: Mass of resin used in the experiment.

ligand_name.description: Name/identity of the ligand or protein loaded onto the resin.

total_volume_ul.description: Total liquid volume per well in the loading experiment.

pump_duration_s.description: Duration for which the pump was running during loading.

salt_concentrations.description: List of salt concentrations used in the experiment.

equilibration_cycles.description: Number of equilibration cycles applied to the resin.

ligand_concentrations.description: List of ligand concentrations used in the experiment.

measurement_wavelength_nm.description: Wavelength used by the plate reader for absorbance measurement.

calibration_curve_slope.description: Slope of the calibration curve converting absorbance to concentration.

salt_concentration_unit.description: Unit of the salt concentrations (e.g. mM).

ligand_concentration_unit.description: Unit of the ligand concentrations (e.g. µM, mg/mL).

calibration_curve_intercept.description: Intercept of the calibration curve converting absorbance to concentration.

number_of_salt_concentrations.description: Number of distinct salt concentrations used.

number_of_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of distinct ligand concentrations used.

analysis_status.description: Status of the Tecan loading isotherm analysis.

analysis_timestamp.description: Timestamp when the analysis results were recorded to the database.

analysis_message.description: Short human-readable summary of the analysis outcome.

experiment_id.description: Experiment ID used by the analysis script.

warnings.description: List of warning messages emitted during analysis.

summary.description: Summary metrics derived from the Langmuir fits and grouped data.

best_r2.description: Best Langmuir fit R^2 across all salt concentrations.

mean_r2.description: Mean Langmuir fit R^2 across all salt concentrations.

data_outputs.description: Key data output file paths produced by the analysis script.

tecan_raw_excel.description: Path to the raw Tecan Excel file used for analysis.

plate_raw_with_mapping_csv.description: CSV file with well-wise absorbance and condition mapping.

grouped_isotherm_csv.description: CSV file with grouped isotherm data (cE_mean, q, etc.).

langmuir_fit_results_csv.description: CSV file with per-salt Langmuir fit parameters and R^2.

analysis_results_json.description: JSON file with the full analysis_results structure from the script.

plots.description: Plot files generated by the analysis script.

loading_isotherms_png.description: PNG plot of loading isotherms with Langmuir fits.

loading_isotherms_pdf.description: PDF plot of loading isotherms with Langmuir fits.

raw_analysis.description: Raw analysis_results dictionary loaded from analysis_results_*.json (if available).

results_folder_listing.description: Listing of files present in the ../results folder at commit time.

analysis_folder_listing.description: Listing of files present in the ../analysis folder at commit time.
